items.title: Creating the Media Agent
items.author: DataTalksClub ⬛
items.summary:
Build a PydanticAI media generation agent with Nebius Token Factory that calls image and video tools, logs tool calls, and inspects generated images before creating videos.


Course: https://datatalks.club/docs/courses/production-ai-agents-generative-media/
GitHub: https://github.com/DataTalksClub/production-ai-agents-for-media-generation

1:57 Setting up Nebius Token Factory API key and OpenAI client
4:33 Configuring PydanticAI with Nebius Token Factory
7:09 Building a simple agent with tools and instructions
11:37 Giving the agent image and video generation tools
15:12 Tracking tool calls with an event stream handler
17:48 Adding an image inspection tool (view_image) before video generation
23:54 Summary and next steps

items.title: The Danger of Closed Models
items.author: AAIF Live
items.summary:
Karan Malhotra, Co-founder of Nous Research, discusses the risks of a fully closed AI ecosystem. He explains how closed models and harnesses favor attackers over defenders, and why he sees open science, open weights and open harnesses as the safest approach.
Follow for more on the agentic stack.

#AgenticAI #AIAgents #OpenSource #AISafety #NousResearch
